messages:
nina: FYI opened PR #3720 — adds a compact OptKit "Quick Migration" example focused on batching + kv_prefetch for short prompts. failing linkcheck and one small naming mismatch (old param name).

joel: I'll take the param rename. which file?

nina: docs/optimize/migrate.md, the Python snippet uses `prefetch=True` instead of `kv_prefetch=True`. also the docs anchor changed from #shortseq to #short-sequences.

pat: Can we also add a one-sentence guidance about q4 profiles? Users keep assuming quantized models behave the same for tiny inputs.

maya: Suggestion: add this line under quant tips: "For very short sequences, q4 variants may show transient higher p50 due to KV-cache warmup; mitigate with a short warmup or slightly larger batch_size." keeps it short.

joel: Pushed a commit fixing the param name and the anchor reference. added a comment in the Python snippet: "# increase batch_size to amortize warmup when using q4"

ci-bot: linkcheck failed on docs/optimize/migrate.md#short-sequences -> 404 (file updated in latest staging).

nina: Hmm, staging renamed it to #shortseqs. I'll update the anchor to match.

pat: Also add a tiny JS example showing `client.settings.max_inflight = 4` so readers see the concurrency knob.

nina: Added the JS line and bumped the changelog note: "Clarify migration examples for batching + kv_prefetch; add KV-cache warmup tip and concurrency note."

ci-bot: CI passed (lint, linkcheck). staging deploy queued (build 7981).

maya: Quick read-through looks good. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

nina: Merging now, will backport to v1.9 docs. closing thread. :tada:
